findings.claim: alpha to coverage turns into multisample coverage
findings.actual: The strands scene pipeline passes coverage=false; alpha_to_coverage_enabled receives that flag. strand_fs computes coverage_mask and writes @builtin(sample_mask); its output alpha is one. The local coverage_mask explanation itself distinguishes this stochastic mechanism from alpha-to-coverage.
findings.replacement: drawn that wide and faded by the share of it that is really there, which a stochastic sample mask turns into multisample coverage: sub-pixel hair integrates to the right density instead of aliasing.
